material.text: @streetturtle/opencode-session-tokens: OpenCode TUI sidebar plugin for session token totals and per-model breakdown

# @streetturtle/opencode-session-tokens OpenCode sidebar plugin for quick session token visibility. ## What it shows - Collapsed: `▶ Session Tokens (<$cost>)` when cost data is available - Expanded: `▼ Session Tokens (<$cost>)` with per-model totals - Falls back to session-level token counters when per-message breakdown is unavailable ## Cost logic - Uses assistant message `cost` values when available - Falls back to session-level `cost` when per-message costs are unavailable ## Counting logic - Per-message spend uses: `input + output + reasoning + cache.write` - Counts assistant messages with token data - De-duplicates repeated assistant messages by message ID ## Install Requires OpenCode 2.0 or newer. ```sh opencode plugin add @streetturtle/opencode-session-tokens ``` Project-only: add `"@streetturtle/opencode-session-tokens"` to `plugins` in `opencode.jsonc`.
